```artifact
Feature: Update Information in System

  Scenario: Admin updates doctor's information
    Given the admin is logged in
    When the admin updates the doctor's name to "Dr. John Smith"
    And the admin updates the doctor's email to "john.smith@example.com"
    Then the doctor's name should be updated to "Dr. John Smith"
    And the doctor's email should be updated to "john.smith@example.com"

  Scenario: Admin updates lab/chemist information
    Given the admin is logged in
    When the admin updates the lab/chemist's name to "Lab XYZ"
    And the admin updates the lab/chemist's email to "lab.xyz@example.com"
    Then the lab/chemist's name should be updated to "Lab XYZ"
    And the lab/chemist's email should be updated to "lab.xyz@example.com"

  Scenario: Patient updates personal details
    Given the patient is logged in
    When the patient updates their name to "Jane Doe"
    And the patient updates their email to "jane.doe@example.com"
    Then the patient's name should be updated to "Jane Doe"
    And the patient's email should be updated to "jane.doe@example.com"

  Scenario: Patient creates appointment
    Given the patient is logged in
    When the patient creates an appointment for tomorrow
    Then the appointment should be created for tomorrow
    And the appointment should be visible in the appointments tab

  Scenario: Admin updates doctor's information with invalid email
    Given the admin is logged in
    When the admin updates the doctor's email to "invalid-email"
    Then an error message should be displayed
    And the doctor's email should not be updated

  Scenario: Admin updates lab/chemist information with invalid name
    Given the admin is logged in
    When the admin updates the lab/chemist's name to ""
    Then an error message should be displayed
    And the lab/chemist's name should not be updated

  Scenario: Patient updates personal details with invalid email
    Given the patient is logged in
    When the patient updates their email to "invalid-email"
    Then an error message should be displayed
    And the patient's email should not be updated

  Scenario: Patient creates appointment with past date
    Given the patient is logged in
    When the patient creates an appointment for yesterday
    Then an error message should be displayed
    And the appointment should not be created
```
